chapter_title_en: Ten Steps to Kill One Man
chapter_seo_title: Slay One Man Every Ten Steps: Xiao Chen Conquers Giant City
chapter_meta_description: Xiao Chen, as a Yellow Diamond skeleton, storms through the Death World, destroying six cities and Giant City. He gathers Life Source Liquid and plans a daring ambush to break through to Yellow Diamond third rank.
og_title: World of Immortality: The Unstoppable Yellow Diamond Rampage
og_description: Xiao Chen's golden skeleton devastates the Death World. After conquering Giant City, he prepares an ambush for the Giant King's returning experts. Life Source Liquid in hand, he aims for a breakthrough.
twitter_title: Death World Conquest: Xiao Chen at Yellow Diamond
twitter_description: Xiao Chen storms Giant City, kills three guardians, and steals Life Source Liquid. Now he plans to ambush seven experts for their fire seeds. Can he reach Yellow Diamond third rank?
